h1: Powering Bahamian Business with 24/7 Autonomous Agents
sub: Delegate research, client comms, and international compliance to dedicated AI agents operating around the clock in isolated cloud computers.
audience: Nassau private wealth advisors, luxury estate brokers, boutique hoteliers, maritime charter coordinators, and international corporate services.
manifesto: Operating across an archipelago and bridging global financial hubs demands continuous capability; Ceyo runs tireless cloud agents that research, analyze, and automate your operations whether you are docked in Nassau or traveling abroad.

uses.d: Manage incoming charter inquiries, cross-reference dockage schedules in Nassau and the Out Islands, and draft bespoke itineraries for international guests.
Deploy coding agents to extract corporate registry updates, organize multi-jurisdictional compliance documents, and sync summaries straight into Notion or Google Sheets.
Agents monitor premium listings across Paradise Island and Cable Beach, drafting instant, personalized responses to high-net-worth international buyer inquiries.
Track provision shipments between Florida and Bahamian ports, reconciling freight manifests and customs declarations automatically via scheduled email routines.
Connect Telegram bot squads to handle global investor scheduling, currency tracking, and routine corporate inquiries across London, New York, and Nassau hours.
Use built-in crypto wallets and live web scraping to watch liquidity pools, market shifts, and regulatory notices while maintaining an audited paper trail.

steps.d: Pick your agent's role, link workspace tools like Gmail and Slack, and launch its isolated cloud computer in seconds.
Invite your specialized agents into individual or group Telegram chats to collaborate directly with your Bahamian team.
Schedule continuous market scans, morning executive briefings, or automated web browsing sessions that run 24/7.

chapters.d: While Nassau wakes up, your agent checks maritime weather advisories, consolidates international currency updates, and delivers a concise digest to your Telegram chat. You review the agenda before heading into the office.

During peak market hours, your bot coordinates charter requests and verifies documentation against private banking checklists. It navigates external portals autonomously without pulling you away from investor meetings.

Your agent checks arrival notices from regional shipping carriers, matching invoices with receipts in Google Drive. You leave the desk knowing all cross-island deliveries are monitored and properly accounted for.

Even with your laptop closed and phone set to silent, your isolated cloud computers test automated workflows and conduct deep research. Global notifications are handled instantly so nothing slips through overnight.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus for $20/month, Pro for $60/month, and Ultra for $120/month. Every plan begins with an unrestricted 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your payment card is linked at registration and charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Can my Bahamian team manage bots via Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo generates custom Telegram bots for personal chats and team groups where several bots collaborate as specialized squads. You can assign tasks, request reports, and trigger complex browser workflows straight from your messaging app.

faq.q: Do the agents run locally on my device?
faq.a: No, each bot operates inside its own isolated cloud computer that stays online 24/7. Your scheduled routines, web research, and coding tasks continue uninterrupted even if your phone or computer is powered off.

faq.q: Which languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo agents converse fluently in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Mandarin, and dozens of other global languages. They easily translate international inquiries, analyze foreign documents, and interact with global clients.

faq.q: Which apps and software can I connect to Ceyo?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with more than 1,000 popular business applications including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, various CRMs, and calendars. Your agents can read data, post updates, and trigger automated cross-platform tasks smoothly.
